verdict.rationale: Elicit hosts a live llms.txt at support.elicit.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed via probe) listing agent-oriented docs, and it also exposes an official MCP server for agent access, showing genuine agent-oriented documentation infrastructure. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no OpenAPI/agent-doc spec beyond the llms.txt itself.
